issue: New entries do not persist across page reload
actual: Added a new entry "QA Test Entry" which appeared immediately in the table. After reloading the page (navigating to the same URL), the entry list reverted to the original 5 seed entries and the new entry, along with a newly added "Notes" field, was gone. localStorage was empty, confirming no persistence mechanism is used.
evidence: localStorage keys: [] after reload; entry count reverted from 6 to 5
Added "Notes" text field via Configure Fields dialog; it immediately appeared as a new column in table view, as a card field in card view, and as an input in the Add Entry form.

Entered "QA Test Entry" (text), 5 (number), 2026-09-01 (date), checked Completed checkbox, and "Test notes value" (notes text). All values were saved and displayed correctly ("Sep 1, 2026", check icon, "Test notes value") in both table and card views.
Switched from Table to Cards view; all 6 entries and their field values (Priority, Due Date, Completed, Notes) remained identical and unchanged.

Field type dropdown clearly lists "Text", "Number", "Date", "Checkbox" with icons. Add Entry form rendered a text input for Task Name, a number spinbutton for Priority, a date picker for Due Date, and a Yes/No toggle checkbox for Completed.

Table view: unchecked shows muted X icon (lucide-x text-muted-foreground), checked shows green check icon (lucide-check text-success). Card view shows explicit "Yes"/"No" text labels alongside icons. Entry form checkbox toggle shows "No"/"Yes" label change.
Empty Notes field values displayed as "—" consistently in both table cells and card fields; all other field values matched between table and card views for every entry.

Sorted Table view by Priority (descending: 3,2,2,1,1). Switched to Cards view: sort reset to unset/default order (independent). Sorted Cards view by Due Date (ascending: Jan14→25). Switched back to Table view: it still showed "Sorted by Priority (descending)" with the same descending order, confirming independent sort state per view.

Selecting "Priority" from Sort menu immediately reordered rows ascending (1,1,2,2,3) and displayed "Sorted by Priority (ascending)". Clicking the Priority column header again toggled to descending (3,2,2,1,1) and updated status text to "Sorted by Priority (descending)". App remained fully interactive throughout.

After sorting by Priority (ascending then descending) and by Due Date in Cards view, the entry count remained "5 entries" throughout and every field value (Task Name, Priority, Due Date, Completed) for each entry stayed identical across all sort operations — only row order changed.

With no sort active, used keyboard drag (Space/ArrowDown/Space on drag handle) to move "Design new landing page" from position 1 to position 3 in Table view (result: Review, Update, Design, Prepare, Team). Switched to Cards view: order was independent (original insertion order until reordered). Reordered Cards moving "Design new landing page" to last (Review, Update, Prepare, Team, Design). Switched back to Table view: it retained its own manual order (Review, Update, Design, Prepare, Team), confirming per-view independent manual ordering. Entry count remained 5 throughout.

issue: No filter feature exists in the application
actual: Searched the entire UI (toolbar, column headers via click and right-click, Fields dialog, row action buttons) for a way to define field-specific filter criteria. Only Search, Sort, Table/Cards toggle, and Add Entry controls exist. A full-page DOM scan confirmed the word "filter" does not appear anywhere in the rendered HTML. There is no way to filter entries by field value.
evidence: document.body.innerHTML.toLowerCase().includes('filter') === false; toolbar buttons list: [Fields, Sort, Table, Cards, Add Entry, column header buttons]

issue: No filter feature exists to verify inclusion/exclusion criteria or restore-on-clear behavior
actual: Since no filtering UI is present anywhere in the app (confirmed via full DOM scan and exhaustive UI exploration), it is impossible to apply field-specific filter criteria, so the constraint that filtering includes exactly matching entries and restores all entries when cleared cannot be satisfied or verified — the feature simply does not exist.

evidence: Typing "design" (lowercase) matched "Design new landing page" (case-insensitive text match), updating count to "1 entry matching \"design\"". Clearing the search via the clear (X) button restored all 5 entries and the previously set manual order.

issue: Quick search matches only internal raw values, not the formatted values shown to users
actual: Searching "Jan 18" (the exact formatted date text displayed as "Jan 18, 2026" in the UI) returned 0 results. Searching the internal raw ISO date "2026-01-18" (not shown anywhere in the UI) correctly matched the "Review marketing materials" entry. Similarly, searching "Yes" (the displayed checkbox state text used in card view and entry form) returned 0 results despite two entries showing "Yes". This shows search only matches raw underlying data, not the formatted/displayed values.
evidence: Search "Jan 18" -> 0 entries; search "2026-01-18" -> 1 entry; search "Yes" -> 0 entries

Priority number field is a native input[type=number]. Attempting to type letters "a", "b", "c" via keyboard keystrokes was rejected by the browser and the field value stayed "0" (Playwright's fill() also threw "Cannot type text into input[type=number]" for "abc"). Entering a valid number "42" was accepted and saved correctly, displaying "42" in the table after submission.

Due Date field uses native input[type=date]. Directly setting an invalid date string "2026-13-45" via the DOM resulted in the input clearing to an empty value (native browser validation rejects invalid dates). Typing "13" as a month segment via keyboard also failed to populate the field (remained empty). Entering a valid date "2026-09-15" was accepted and correctly saved/displayed as "Sep 15, 2026" in the table after submission.

issue: No import feature exists in the application
actual: Searched the entire UI (toolbar, Configure Fields dialog, Add Entry dialog, row action buttons) for a way to import data. Only the Configure Fields dialog contains a text note stating "Configure fields before importing data," but no actual import button, file upload control, or import dialog exists anywhere. A full-page DOM scan confirmed the word "import" does not appear in any interactive element — it's only referenced in that static help text. There is no way to import data into the app.
evidence: document.body.innerHTML.toLowerCase().includes('import') === false when checking for actionable controls; only static note text mentions "importing data" with no functional import control
